title: A recorded patch changes only the state
statement: Let $K\in\mathbb{N}$, let $\Gamma$ and $P$ be types, let $x$ be a word over $\Gamma$, and let $d$ be a configuration with $K+1$ work tapes and states in $P$. If tape $0$ of $d$ records a field list $f_s$ at every integer offset from $-1$ through the length of its joined field word, then patching $d$ with state $q$ and fields $f_s$ gives the configuration obtained from $d$ by changing its state to $q$ and leaving all other data unchanged.
